# Wikipedia

> > The free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit, covering millions of topics in hundreds of languages.

Wikipedia is a collaborative encyclopedia founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, operated by the Wikimedia Foundation. The English Wikipedia is the largest edition, featuring articles on everything from historical figures like Queen Victoria to technical topics, with content created and maintained by volunteer editors called Wikipedians.

## Key Topics

- Free knowledge and open collaboration
- Wikimedia Foundation governance
- Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger (founders)
- Wikipedians (volunteer editors)
- English Wikipedia (largest edition)
- Wiki platform and PHP technology
- Featured articles and daily content
- Encyclopedia structure and navigation
- Wikipedia history and evolution
- Disambiguation pages
- Queen Victoria and British history
- Date notation and calendar systems
- Cross-referencing and hyperlinks
- Neutral point of view (NPOV)
- Verifiability and citations

## About Wikipedia

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia homepage featuring Queen Victoria's Young Head coinage article
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Wikipedia article about itself, founded by Jimmy Wales & Larry Sanger
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Wikipedia's collaborative encyclopedia mission
- [English Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): English edition of Wikipedia managed by Wikimedia Foundation
- [Wikipedia:Contents - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Site directory and navigation hub for browsing Wikipedia topics

## Wikipedia History & Development

- [History of Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Wikipedia's origins from Nupedia to global encyclopedia

## Reference & Disambiguation

- [// - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki///): Disambiguation for double-slash notation in C, C++, Java, JavaScript
- [Lists of capital cities - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lists_of_capitals): Index of national and subnational capital cities worldwide
- [British - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British): Disambiguation for British identity, UK, Great Britain, and territories
- [10.5 - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/10.5): Disambiguation for 10.5: NBC miniseries and Mac OS X Leopard version
- [12345 - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/12345): Disambiguation for 12345: Schenectady ZIP code, train, minor planet
